profile.headline: Advanced Software Engineer at Honeywell Intelligrated
profile.summary: Seasoned advanced software engineer with a proven track record of designing, developing, deploying, and supporting innovative full-stack software projects. Unique multi-disciplinary skills, honed through education, set one apart in the field. Proven ability to quickly learn new skills and knowledge, combined with a persistent pursuit of excellence, ensures consistent and reliable delivery of high-quality and cutting-edge solutions in every project undertaken.

positions.title: Advanced Software Engineer
positions.description:
+ Front-end development with various JavaScript frameworks 
+ Back-end development for Windows and QNX using C++
+ C++, C#, Java, JavaScript, ReactJS, TypeScript
+ Custom JavaScript UI frameworks based on Kendo UI and React
+ Custom realtime distributed objects technology framework in C++
positions.insights: Skills: C++ · Realtime Programming · Debugging Code · Full-Stack Development · JavaScript
